title: Core: paste in place (preserve original coordinates)
description: Add pasteInPlace(doc, sceneIndex, layerIndex, frameIndex, objects): FlashDocument to packages/core/src/engine/mutations.ts. Flash 8's Edit > Paste in Place pastes objects at their ORIGINAL coordinates (same x/y as when they were copied), unlike regular Paste which centers at stage. The clipboard (from 0068/clipboard-ops) currently pastes at center — add a variant that skips the centering offset. Also add copyWithPosition() that records absolute position alongside the clipboard. Add 5 tests in __tests__/pasteInPlace.test.ts.
